name: When should I start coordinating appliance installation with my construction project?

mainEntity.name: When should I start coordinating appliance installation with my construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should begin coordinating appliance installation early in your construction or renovation project, ideally during the design or planning phase. This allows sufficient time to order appliances, confirm specifications, and prepare the site for delivery and hook-up. Early coordination with Frasheski Construction ensures that the necessary utility rough-ins are correctly placed and sized, avoiding last-minute changes that can impact project timelines and budgets in areas like Oakland or Albany.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start coordinating appliance installation during the design or planning phase of your project to ensure correct utility rough-ins and avoid delays.
